name: ASCON
tagline: Roadside help, towing, accident claims and car insurance for drivers in Uzbekistan
role: Mobile development for a roadside-assistance service in Uzbekistan

scenes.title: One app for drivers in trouble
scenes.body: Roadside repair, accident claims, tow trucks and compulsory car insurance, in Russian and Uzbek.

scenes.title: Every service on one map
scenes.body: Google Maps pins the driver's location, then one tap requests technical help, accident support or a tow.

scenes.title: Price agreed before dispatch
scenes.body: A mechanic call-out shows its fixed fee up front, and the driver confirms before the request goes out.

scenes.title: For drivers and mechanics
scenes.body: RU / UZ language switch, a service price list, support, and sign-up for mechanics joining the network.

scenes.title: Car insurance, priced in-app
scenes.body: An OSGO calculator prices the policy by vehicle type, region, insurance term and number of drivers.

scenes.title: Tech passport to e-policy
scenes.body: Plate and tech-passport details return the premium and coverage split, then the driver pays in-app.
